findings.why_it_matters: A heading at the wrong level breaks the document outline: tools that slice the transcription by heading treat 5.11.4 as a sibling of clause 5.11 rather than a subclause of it.
findings.note: The subclause heading 5.11.4 is transcribed at level 2 (##), the level of the clause heading 5.11 THE RENAMES CLAUSE. Its siblings are level 3: page 272 has '### ║5.11.3 Syntax Rules║', and page 271 has '### 5.10.4 General Rules'. It should be '### ║5.11.4 General Rules║'.
